title: Jellyfish Shut Down a 1,400-Megawatt Nuclear Reactor in Sweden

scenes.text: Jellyfish shut down a nuclear reactor.
In 2013, tons of moon jellyfish swarmed Sweden's Oskarshamn plant.
They clogged the pipes that bring in cooling water.
That reactor makes 1,400 megawatts, about five percent of Sweden's power.
Operators had to switch it off.
Jellyfish have also stopped plants in California and Florida.
A soft, brainless animal beat a power plant.

description:
Jellyfish shut down a nuclear reactor.
In 2013, tons of moon jellyfish clogged the cooling water intake at Sweden's Oskarshamn plant. The 1,400 megawatt unit had to be switched off.
Which animal would you bet could take down a power plant? Comment below.
first_comment: Jellyfish have no brain, no heart and no bones. Which of those surprises you most?
